QuestLog.Title: Quest Log
QuestLog.EditingNote: Editing. Changes save as you go.
QuestLog.HiddenNotice: Hidden. Players can't see this quest until you reveal it.

Quest.Name: Quest name
Quest.LimitedNote: You know this quest exists, but not its details.
Quest.InProgressHint: Show this quest on the Quest Beacon for everyone who can see it
Quest.DropGiver: Drop an actor, item, or journal entry
Quest.GMNotesEmpty: No GM notes yet. Add some in edit mode.

Objective.Name: Objective
Objective.Show: Hidden from players. Click to show
Objective.HideAction: Visible to players. Click to hide

Page.EditInLog: Quests are edited in the Quest Log.

Theme.Name: Quest Log theme
Theme.Hint: Applies to your client only. Follow Foundry matches your core light or dark interface setting.

DefaultOwnership.Name: Player access when a quest is revealed
DefaultOwnership.Hint: Hidden quests give players no access. When a quest leaves Hidden, all players get this level. Adjust single quests with Foundry's ownership controls.
DefaultOwnership.Limited: Limited: name, status, and giver only

ShowInProgress.Name: Show the Quest Beacon
ShowInProgress.Hint: Shows the In Progress quest and its objectives above the players list. Applies to your client only.

ShowNextObjective.Name: Show objectives on the Quest Beacon
ShowNextObjective.Hint: Lists the quest's objectives under its name on the Beacon.

AutoUnlockRewards.Name: Unlock rewards when a quest is completed
AutoUnlockRewards.Hint: Rewards start locked. When on, marking a quest Completed lets players claim its rewards.

FollowerOwnership.Name: Access granted by actor rewards
FollowerOwnership.Hint: When a player claims an actor reward (a follower or mount), they get this access to it.

Reward.Name: Reward
Reward.Show: Hidden from players. Click to show
Reward.HideAction: Visible to players. Click to hide
Reward.GiveHint: Give this reward to a player
Reward.Unlock: Locked. Click to let players claim it
Reward.LockedNote: Locked until the GM releases it
Reward.UndoItem: Also remove {item} from {actor}? Choose No to keep it there and only clear the claim.
Reward.NoRecipients: No players can receive this reward.
Reward.NoCharacter: You don't own a character to receive this.
Reward.NeedGM: A GM must be connected to hand out rewards.

Error.NotGM: Only a GM can do that.
Error.Locked: That reward isn't available to claim yet.
Error.AlreadyClaimed: That reward has already been claimed.
Error.SourceMissing: The original item or actor no longer exists.

Rejected.giver: Quest givers can be actors, items, or journal entries.
Rejected.rewards: Rewards can be items or actors.

Drop.CannotOpen: You don't have permission to open that.

Beacon.Label: Quest Beacon: {name}. Open in Quest Log.

Folders.Name: Folder name
Folders.OutsideHint: These quests were moved out of the FHQL Quests journal folder.

Import.Title: Import from Forien's Quest Log
Import.Intro: These quests were found in Forien's Quest Log data. Importing adds a Fallhammer quest page to each quest's existing journal entry, so links to them keep working.
Import.Safe: FQL's own data is never changed. Quests already imported are skipped unless you tick Re-import.
Import.OverwriteHint: Replace this quest with FQL's version. Edits made here since the last import are lost.
Import.MoveOption: Move imported quests into FHQL Quests › Imported from FQL
Import.MoveHint: Recommended. FQL only reads its own hidden folder, so if you re-enable FQL later it won't see moved quests. Untick to leave them where they are; they'll show in the log under Outside FHQL Quests.
Import.NoneFound: No Forien's Quest Log quests were found in this world.

Fix.MissingParent: its parent quest no longer exists, so it's now top level.
Fix.MissingSubquest: listed a subquest that no longer exists; dropped.
Fix.AdoptedParent: had no parent, but {parent} listed it as a subquest; parent set to {parent}.
Fix.ConflictingParent: {other} also listed it as a subquest; kept its own parent, {kept}.
Fix.ParentLoop: its parents looped back to itself; made top level.
Fix.Unmapped: FQL fields with no equivalent here, not imported: {fields}.
Fix.NameDiffers: FQL's stored name was "{name}"; kept the journal entry's name.
Fix.HiddenAccess: hidden quest: player access removed so it stays hidden.
Fix.HasQuestPage: already has a Fallhammer quest page not made by this importer; left alone.
